page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 16 virtual CPUs driven by an 8-core Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz with hyperthreading enabled. It is configured with 64 GB of dedicated system memory, yielding a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor with x86_64 hardware architecture, supporting hardware acceleration instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AES. Dedicated local storage and GPU accelerators are not bundled with this configuration, while baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results show distinct baseline characteristics between single-threaded and multi-threaded performance. Single-core processing registers in the lower performance quartile, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 1001.0 and a single-core stress-ng metric of 1106.79. However, multi-threaded throughput achieves average performance tiers across standard cloud benchmarks, scoring 6324.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 11798.08 on stress-ng multi-core. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 75.86 GB/s, supporting average operational performance in multi-threaded database tasks, such as Redis SET operations at 11.35 million requests per second and static web serving throughput of 9.98 GB/s.

The hardware profile provides balanced resource density for parallelized multi-core compute tasks, though its lower per-core clock rate presents a performance bottleneck for single-threaded applications or heavy compression tasks like single-threaded gzip. Lacking integrated local storage, storage operations rely entirely on remote network-attached block volumes over its 3 Gbps baseline network link. The ecs.sn2.3xlarge instance offers reasonable cost-efficiency for multi-threaded general-purpose workloads, including web serving, software compilation, medium-scale database hosting, and light machine learning inference.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance equipped with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores at 2.5 GHz and 64 GB of RAM. Running on a KVM hypervisor with x86_64 architecture, it includes instruction set extensions like AVX-512 and AES. The instance lacks bundled local storage and GPU hardware, depending on network storage while providing a 3 Gbps baseline network capacity. Benchmark results indicate weak single-core CPU scores alongside average multi-core CPU, memory bandwidth, and web serving metrics. Multi-threaded software compilation and database operations perform solidly within average industry tiers. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio delivers balanced resource allocation without dedicated storage overhead, making ecs.sn2.3xlarge suitable for general web hosting, microservice backends, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and database tasks that utilize multi-core parallelism effectively.
